Nonnull helper only reads CURRENT raw randomsize; below.3 returns1, otherwise currenttag. Separate public form is consumed by seven renderer preRender callbacks. CLIENT ComputeFov reads actual camera/current item/use ticks and local fov_smoothen to adjust only ViewportEvent.FOV. No gameplay motion/status/ray/projectile request. Dead local upside_down_mode startsfalse with no setter in this body; no active200 FOV contribution inferred. Native weapon and camera-state writers remain separate.

CLIENT RenderLevelStage drives native GPU buffers/shader/pose geometry for waypoints, Tormentor boundaries and spheres. It writes actual CLIENT camera attachment overlay_red/white/black and current_ascendant/asc_subchain/asc_xyz scratch values; preserve those writes instead of claiming read-only. Field index proves scratch coordinates are used only by this renderer and native attachment serialization/clone. Overlay readers are UI; prior GameMode/Sphere/beam writers remain canonical. syncPlayerVariables only transmits for actual ServerPlayer, not this client camera; existing CLIENTBOUND-only state transport cannot apply client scratch to server. No sendToServer, hurt/effect/heal/motion/entity spawn or native owner assignment. Geometry dimensions/opacities are presentation, not another forcefield damage/radius. Actual AscendSphereAnim native barrier/owner/control stays separate.

CLIENT RenderLevelStage reads local laser/SlowLook state and creates GPU geometry only. No attachment/world/entity-data write, damage, status, attack registration or native beam owner assignment. Native TormentorLaser payload and SlowLook lifecycle remain canonical; shader/body-shape dimensions are not extra attack scalars.

CLIENT dimension-special-effects event stores its provider then calls previously closed EMPTY static Event execute body. It does NOT register any factory effects from this callback. The five static register/createEffects overloads have ZERO native callers/handles and no method event annotations; preserve only their native unreferenced client setup context, not an active combat/encounter path. Class EventBusSubscriber does not register every unannotated helper; external reflection/runtime absence is not asserted.

Live EntityTick.Pre wrapper calls Event overload, then POP2 discards constant1.48. Helper ignores event and writes no bounding box/state. Unscoped no-arg overload was independently proven unused; do not mistake class name or returned double for an active collision contribution.

Native size/skin reads only select renderer scale; exact native callers are TamedTarantulaRenderer.preRender. No entity-data setter, dimension change, damage or owner transfer; locked physical/owner contract remains separate.
Constant visual return only; native consumers are five tier renderer preRender methods. No physical size/source/damage parameter is produced.

Native ownerkills and patreon_reskin reads yield0.1+nextDouble(kills,kills)/100+nextDouble(skin,skin). Equal-bound native Mth contract reused, not an independent random growth distribution. Renderer preRender only; ownerkills combat damage/defense consumers remain canonical, no second counter or size magnitude.

CLIENT RenderFog FOG_TERRAIN reads actual camera, current Tormentor map/dimension/Breathless. Changes only near/far fog planes and fog-event cancellation, not damage-event cancellation, visibility admission or physical range. Existing Breathless/Tormentor combat is canonical and unchanged.
CLIENT ComputeFogColor changes only eventRGB/native graphicsblend from Crawling/Breathless/Y checks. No world tint as a gameplay status, original damage cancellation or native armor gate inferred.

CLIENT AFTER_PARTICLES model callback only draws trophy/satchel/distant Tormentor representations with native pose transforms. Trophy branch creates a fresh entity in current Minecraft ClientLevel, sets THAT display copy silent/invulnerable; does not set queried world victim invulnerable. Cached display entities never addFreshEntity/spawn/tick; native world Tormentor actors are only read/rendered, not rotated/teleported/harmed by this body. Fake BlockEntity is created for drawing and given clientlevel without insertion/ticking. Inventory helper gets native slot then returns COPY; no replacement or consume. World/map/raw data are display inputs, not new source/owner or independent combat values.
